intent: Write the test for StepLog (context telemetry-ingestion-processing) at the test file path; the unit under test lives at src/main/java/com/pulsestream/telemetry/shared/observability/StepLog.java. Assert only against the tabled surface. Step-log emitter: the single place where contractual step facts are logged. Instance class with a no-arg constructor; emit writes one INFO structured event through SLF4J key-value pairs carrying step (the step name) and correlationId. Level and format are configuration literals; business units never call a raw logger for step facts. TEST DUTIES: Attach a logback ListAppender, call emit and assert one INFO event whose message/key-values contain the step name and correlationId.
